crossRefs.note: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of…
crossRefs.keyword: that they may be destroyed. Heb. to destroy them. and Iwill pay. Heb. and I will weigh

crossRefs.note: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

translations.web: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”
translations.bsb: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will deposit ten thousand talents of silver into the royal treasury to pay those who carry it out.”
translations.kjv: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.
translations.asv: If it please the king, let it be written that they be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those that have the charge of the kings' business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.
